summary: Phase 1d (PDF export, protection score badge on advisor roster, insights history, estate waterfall) end-to-end tested. 7/7 backend tests pass. All 4 frontend features verified via Playwright. No issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: Nice: insights.py append-with-cap-10 and GET /plan/insights/history both resolve correctly now that insights.router is included before planning.router (prior iteration's shadowing fix held).

report_pdf endpoint recomputes protection_score inline (planning.py:413-420) while advisor.py uses _protection_score helper — consider centralising into one helper (engine/protection.py) so the heuristic can't drift between advisor roster and PDF.
/report/pdf streams a single-chunk iter([pdf]); for larger plans consider chunked streaming to lower peak memory.
AdvisorClients.jsx protection column renders '—' when protection_score is null — good; but visually '40/100' badge for client_a1 has no color-coding (low score = red). Minor UX polish, not a bug.
Tax.jsx estate-waterfall uses hardcoded legend colors — consider pulling from a shared palette constant so the segmented bar colors always match the legend swatches.
